visual.general_description: Close-up color photograph of a large glossy dark red to black swelling attached to a pale wrinkled tubular structure on a pink-peach background.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph. A pale cream-colored, wrinkled tubular structure sits at the top center of the frame with scattered small dark red-brown specks on its surface. A large glossy, elongated swelling in dark red to black tones extends from it diagonally toward the lower left edge, with a brighter red zone along its upper margin and a small drip-like projection at the lower left edge. The surrounding background is smooth pink-peach skin-toned surface with a faint curved crease near the lower right. No panel letters, arrows, ruler, scale bar, printed text or border labels are visible.
